//! GPU-resident camera and reference metadata.
//! Epochs invalidate orbit checkpoints without clearing the large buffers.

pub struct ViewCache {
    pub x0: f32,
    pub x1: f32,
    pub x2: f32,
    pub x3: f32,
    pub y0: f32,
    pub y1: f32,
    pub y2: f32,
    pub y3: f32,
    pub zoom: f32,
    pub res: f32,
    pub cursor: u32,
    pub aa: f32,
    pub budget: u32,
    pub radius: f32,
    pub preview_dirty: u32,
    pub blur_dirty: u32,
    pub epoch: u32,
    pub completed: u32,
}
pub struct ReferenceControl {
    pub active: u32,
    pub active_valid: u32,
    pub pending: u32,
    pub index: u32,
    pub zx_s: u32,
    pub zy_s: u32,
    pub ready_at: f32,
}
pub struct ReferenceAnchor {
    pub x0: f32,
    pub x1: f32,
    pub x2: f32,
    pub x3: f32,
    pub y0: f32,
    pub y1: f32,
    pub y2: f32,
    pub y3: f32,
    pub limit: u32,
    pub generation: u32,
}

/// Persistent numeric history, separate from both color and live checkpoints.
/// The associated ViewCache records the exact camera and iteration budget.
pub struct SampleOracle {
    pub iteration:u32,
    pub magnitude:f32,
    pub flags:u32,
}

impl Copy for ViewCache {}

/// Numeric samples can be reused only for the identical sampling lattice.
/// Reprojected colors alone never establish this identity.
pub fn same_camera(_ a:ViewCache,_ b:ViewCache) -> bool {
    a.x0==b.x0 && a.x1==b.x1 && a.x2==b.x2 && a.x3==b.x3
        && a.y0==b.y0 && a.y1==b.y1 && a.y2==b.y2 && a.y3==b.y3
        && a.zoom==b.zoom && a.res==b.res
}
